THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Rൾඏඈർൺඍංඈඇ ඎඇൽൾඋ Sൾർඍංඈඇ 39(1)

THE allotments of land speciﬁ ed morefully in the Order No.198 of 2020 dated 26.10.2020 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2209/05 dated 04.01.2021 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order in respect of the lands speciﬁ ed in the Schedule of the Order No. 198 of 2020 dated 26.10.2020 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2209/05 dated 04.01.2021. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
